decision_description: gate_12_constitutional_compliance failed twice on false negatives caused by a consistency gap in constitutional amendment C1 (instrument-conditional budget gate, CLAUDE.md §8.1/§8.4): C1 conditionalised gate_09's predicates by budget_regime but left gate_12's budget predicates unconditional. Both g11_p07 (deterministic, budget_gate_confirmation_present) and g11_p10 (semantic, no_budget_gate_contradiction) read docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json, a lump-sum-scoped artifact that the budget-interface-validation skill is contractually required to write with gate_pass_declaration 'fail' when integrations/received/ is empty. For the active unit-cost instrument (MSCA-PF), the sanctioned budget source is the §8.1 deterministic derivation in unit_cost_budget.json (run 49dc10ca, gate_pass_declaration 'pass', all components Confirmed, total EUR 220723.50), and gate_09 passed on that basis on 2026-09-02. Resolution: gate_12's budget predicates were made instrument-conditional, mirroring gate_09's C1 split — g11_p07 and g11_p10 now carry applies_when {budget_regime: lump_sum} (preserved verbatim otherwise); new g11_uc01 (deterministic, unit_cost_budget_resolved) and g11_uc02 (semantic, no_budget_gate_contradiction_unit_cost) carry applies_when {budget_regime: unit_cost} and judge against unit_cost_budget.json. Predicate registrations updated in manifest.compile.yaml and quality_gates.yaml; semantic registry entry added in runner/semantic_dispatch.py. budget_gate_assessment.json was NOT edited: its 'fail' declaration is correct for what it measures (absence of a lump-sum external response) and hand-editing it to 'pass' would fabricate a lump-sum confirmation in violation of §8.3.
alternatives_considered: Hand-edit budget_gate_assessment.json to gate_pass_declaration 'pass' — rejected: contradicts the budget-interface-validation skill contract (Mode B empty-received MUST write 'fail') and would fabricate a lump-sum confirmation (§8.3, §13.7).
Remove g11_p07/g11_p10 from gate_12 — rejected: weakens the gate for lump-sum instruments (§13.7); the budget confirmation must remain positively required for both regimes.
Repoint g11_p07/g11_p10 args at unit_cost_budget.json unconditionally — rejected: breaks lump-sum instruments and the §2 programme-agnostic mission.

Re-run Phase 7 to overwrite the assessment — rejected: the skill would deterministically write 'fail' again (received/ is empty by design for unit-cost); the artifact is not wrong, the predicate scoping was.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §8.1/§8.4 as amended by C1 (instrument-conditional budget source), §14.4 (consistency requirement extended to the gate_12 predicate set), §12.3 (explicit contradiction resolution: the unit-cost Tier 4 derivation artifact prevailed over the lump-sum-scoped assessment artifact for the resolved budget_regime 'unit_cost'), §9.2 (run-context node-state reset in .claude/runs/ is runtime memory, not Tier 4 state).
rationale: The categorical Phase-8 block (§8.4/§13.4) is preserved and instrument-independent: gate_12 still requires a positive budget confirmation in both regimes, sourced per C1. The contradiction between the two Phase 7 artifacts (assessment 'fail' vs derivation 'pass') is resolved by scoping, not by preference: each artifact is authoritative only for its regime. The unit-cost derivation carries the anti-fabrication guarantee (byte-equal deterministic replay) that the external response carries for lump-sum. A follow-up remains open: the n07 node body still runs the lump-sum budget-interface-validation skill under a unit-cost regime, which plants a misleading 'fail' assessment each run; that skill invocation should be made regime-conditional in a future change.
